extDescription: Your new tab as an interactive graph of bookmarks: folders, tags and the tabs you already have open.
hint: click opens (or switches to the tab if already open) · ⌘click new tab · right-click edits and tags · º: only open · type to search
tabCountTitle: Open tabs matching bookmarks · click or press º to show only the open ones
sessionsTitle: Save and restore sets of windows (with tab groups)
emptyNoBookmarksBody: Import bookmarks from chrome://bookmarks and they will show up here as a graph.
emptyNoOpenBody: No open tab matches your bookmarks. Press º or the ⧉ button to see everything.
tooltipGoToTab: click: go to the open tab
badgeOnlyOpen: ⧉ only open ($1) — press º to see all
badgeNoTabsPermission: ⧉ no tab access — the «tabs» permission is missing
badgeHiddenUrls: ⧉ Chrome is hiding URLs — accept the «tabs» permission in chrome://extensions
dlgTagFolderNote: Adds the tags to the $1 bookmarks in the folder (without removing existing ones).
dlgDeleteTagNote: It will be removed from every bookmark. The bookmarks themselves are not touched.
dlgDeleteFolderNote: The folder and its $1 bookmarks will be deleted.
dlgSaveSessionNote: Saves which tabs are in each window, their order, which are pinned, the groups (title, colour, collapsed) and the position and size of each window.
dlgSaveSessionNoGroups: ⚠ The «tabGroups» permission is NOT active right now: groups would be saved without title or colour.
diagOnlyInExtension: Diagnostics only make sense inside the extension
toastPreviewNoSave: Preview: changes are not saved to Chrome
toastPreviewGoToTab: Preview: would switch to the tab «$1»
toastPreviewRestore: Preview: would open $1 window(s) with $2 tabs
toastTagsSeeded: Starter tags generated — right-click › Tags to edit them
toastUnpinAll: All nodes released — physics is rearranging the view
toastNoTabsToSave: There are no tabs to save in that scope
toastTabError: Could not switch to the tab: $1
toastPermissionGranted: Permission granted — open a new tab to finish activating it
toastMissingPermissions: ⚠ Permissions not applied: $1 — disable and re-enable GraphMarks in chrome://extensions
toastNoTabGroups: Tab groups are saved without name or colour: the «tabGroups» permission is missing
toastSessionLocalOnly: Session saved on this device only (could not sync: $1)
toastSessionNoGroupMeta: — without the «tabGroups» permission groups will be restored with no title or colour
toastSessionRestoredSplit: Session «$1» restored — Chrome does not let extensions recreate split view; the pair is left selected: right-click the selection → «split view»
